title: Corinthians Gains Advantage Over Bahia in Women's Brasileiro
subtitle: Historic Match Records Record Attendance at Arena Fonte Nova
excerpt: Corinthians secures an advantage against Bahia in a match that shattered women's football attendance records in Salvador.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The match between Corinthians and Bahia, part of the Women's Brasileiro Championship, resulted in an advantage for the São Paulo-based team. The clash took place at Arena Fonte Nova, in Salvador, and marked a historic moment for women's football in Bahia.

The event recorded the highest number of spectators ever seen for the sport in the region, with 5,811 people present, of whom 5,758 paid for tickets. Despite the impressive turnout, the attendance was not enough to fill all available seats.

The match result puts Corinthians ahead in the standings, strengthening their position in the tournament while Bahia looks to bounce back in the upcoming rounds.

With information from Agência Brasil.
